findings.name: Manipulation player-target aggro
findings.native_fact: ManipulationEffect extends harmful MobEffect. On server, only an affected Player triggers its logic: Piglin and ZombifiedPiglin instances within the player's bounding box inflated by 20 have their target changed to that player. It ticks when remaining duration modulo 20 equals zero; amplifier is unused in its implementation.
findings.observed_deliveries: ManipulatorStickItem.hurtEnemy and its ordinary use path each add NetherExp.MANIPULATION_EFFECT with duration 600 and amplifier 0. The effect can be installed on other LivingEntities, but this class's tick action requires Player.

findings.name: Manipulator Stick pull
findings.native_fact: Non-sneaking use rejects insufficient remaining durability (<20). It samples the player's eye/look ray from 0.5 to 15 in steps of 0.5, querying living entities in a box inflated by 0.6 at each point, choosing the first alive non-user target encountered. On a target it applies Manipulation, sets velocity x/z from normalize(player.position - target.position)*1.4 and y=0.4, sets hurtMarked, spends 20 durability and returns success. No block-ray obstruction test or ordinary-use cooldown was present in the reviewed method.

findings.name: Held-stick fleeing navigation
findings.native_fact: ManipulatorStickEvents.onEntityTick runs server-side every fourth entity tick. For Villager or AbstractPiglin, it finds the nearest player within 12 holding the stick in either hand, asks DefaultRandomPos.getPosAway with horizontal/vertical ranges 16/7, and if a position exists asks navigation to move there at speed 1.3. This is a navigation request, not a guaranteed action lock or a named fear MobEffect.

findings.name: Owned Wither Skeleton summon and target filtering
findings.native_fact: Sneaking stick use requires 50 available durability, attempts five Wither Skeleton creations, equips gold armor/sword, suppresses equipment drops, writes SummonerUUID, spends 50 durability and sets item cooldown 40. Every fourth server entity tick, an owned skeleton without a target selects the first eligible Player/Monster in a box inflated by 16, excluding owner, AzazelEntity and WitherSkeleton. LivingChangeTargetEvent also cancels those excluded targets and targets outside Player/Monster categories.

findings.name: Chance Totem death cancellation, relocation and effect bundle
findings.native_fact: HIGH-priority LivingDeathEvent handler for ServerPlayer checks main hand, then offhand, then Curios helper if loaded. With a non-null totem it cancels death, sets HP to 1, removes all effects, consumes one item, teleports to the recorded respawn dimension/position (overworld/shared-spawn fallbacks), then adds vanilla Resistance amplifier 4, Invisibility 0, Blindness 1, Weakness 2, Regeneration 4 and Slowness 0, all duration 600. No random success test occurs in this reviewed handler despite the display name.
findings.pending: Curios helper, exact registry ID, vanilla totem comparison, and death-event interaction/eligibility remain unreviewed. This is observed source-mod behavior; no such action was executed by research.

findings.name: ZoneEffect marker requires consumer review
findings.native_fact: ZoneEffect only invokes the neutral MobEffect constructor with its supplied color. Other event/client consumers were not reviewed, so this is not evidence that zone states are cosmetic or combat-inert.
